products: Azure API Management AI gateway capabilities
capabilities.role: Control requests sent to models and APIs, the interfaces used by software, and access supported foundation models, which are pre-trained models used for different tasks.
capabilities.limit: The separate AI Gateway tier is public preview. It is distinct from the existing API Management gateway capabilities; do not assume each tier supports the same traffic rules.

capabilities.role: Find source passages with keyword search (matching words), vector search (matching numerical representations of meaning) or hybrid search (combining both).
Run agents in a managed environment, including prompt agents, hosted agents and their tools. An agent requests actions; a tool is an operation it can call.
capabilities.limit: Using managed orchestration to coordinate agent steps and hosting your own agent code are different paths.

capabilities.role: Run custom model-training scripts and publish managed inference endpoints, the addresses applications call to request model outputs.
Evaluate models, agents, datasets or captured traces. A trace records steps within a request; telemetry is the recorded activity used to inspect what the agent did.
Converse gives applications a consistent way to send messages to supported Bedrock models. AgentCore Gateway exposes capabilities that an agent can call.
capabilities.limit: The Bedrock inference endpoint receives model requests; AgentCore Gateway has a different job. Individual models still have their own features.

capabilities.role: Manage retrieval, the search for relevant source passages, and retrieval-augmented generation, which supplies those passages to a model when it answers.
capabilities.limit: The team still chooses the vector backend, which stores searchable numerical representations, and how source documents are prepared and loaded.

capabilities.role: Host agent applications and connect the infrastructure services they use. Hosting supplies the environment in which the agent code runs.
capabilities.limit: A runtime provides an environment to run an agent. The application still needs a correct tool loop: choosing an action, checking its result and deciding what happens next.

capabilities.role: Train custom models and deploy inference endpoints, the addresses applications call to request model outputs.
Evaluate agent behaviour and inspect recorded sessions, traces and metrics. A trace records request steps; metrics are measured counts or values.
capabilities.limit: The dataset evaluation runner is documented as public preview. That status applies to this runner, not automatically to the wider evaluation service.

platforms.label: Google Cloud
platforms.name_note: In the recorded documentation check, the Vertex AI Agent Engine, Model Garden, Vector Search, training and evaluation URLs redirected to Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. Keep Vertex AI and Agent Engine as search aliases, so readers can find the older names; do not assume those are the current page titles.

capabilities.role: Access models managed by the provider or deployed by your team, and govern configured connections used by agents.
capabilities.limit: Agent Gateway controls agent connections; Model Garden provides model access. They do different jobs and are not interchangeable interfaces for model requests.

capabilities.role: Run managed vector similarity search: compare numerical representations to find similar items.
capabilities.limit: This Vector Search page is distinct from the separately named Agent Retrieval product, formerly Vector Search 2.0.

capabilities.role: Agent Runtime provides the environment that runs an agent. Agent Development Kit (ADK) provides software building blocks for agents and their sequences of steps.
Train custom models and deploy their weights, the learned numerical parameters, on cloud computing resources.
Evaluate outputs and inspect request traces, logs and metrics. Traces show the steps of an agent request; logs record events; metrics measure counts or values.

platforms.title: GCP

capabilities.role: Send and route model requests to supported model providers.
Connect external providers such as Upstash Vector or MongoDB Atlas to retrieve similar items using numerical representations.
capabilities.limit: These are connections to external providers, not a Vercel-owned vector database. Review each provider’s regions, access permissions and data-retention rules separately.

capabilities.role: Run application code that coordinates tool calls and durable workflows, which retain progress across interruptions. Deploy that application code using the listed products.
capabilities.limit: AI SDK is a library included in an application. It does not itself supply a hosted model or the cloud environment that runs the code.

capabilities.role: Host application code and connect it to a service that runs or trains models.
capabilities.limit: The reviewed documentation did not establish a general managed GPU training service. A GPU is a processor commonly used for model training. This is not evidence of a SageMaker-equivalent training service or a claim that every form of training is impossible.

capabilities.role: Inspect model requests, spend and application execution. Connect telemetry, the recorded activity, to a chosen evaluation process.
capabilities.limit: Request records and spend do not score answer quality. The checked AI SDK documentation includes experimental evaluation callbacks, functions called during evaluation. This review does not establish an equivalent managed service for evaluation against a golden dataset, a reviewed set of reference cases.
